name: Multivariate Functional Approximation
definition: A continuous volume representation that uses control points and a polynomial degree to evaluate off-grid sample locations with higher accuracy than trilinear interpolation, while approximating C1 continuity across partition boundaries without requiring ghost voxels.
summary: Multivariate Functional Approximation models 3D scalar fields using B-splines to provide higher-order continuity than trilinear interpolation, reducing artifacts without ghost voxels.
